employee_extension_schema.title: JP employee extension data
employee_extension_schema.description: Additional local compliance data on the sealed contract, stored as employee_extension_data. Shared salary, allowances, work classifications, dates and work arrangements are native fields.

family_care_recipients.title: 要介護状態の対象家族の数
family_care_recipients.description: 育児・介護休業法 art.16の5: family members in need of care the worker looks after — two or more give 10 介護休暇 days a year instead of 5.

resident_tax_special_collection_switch.title: 特別徴収への切替希望
resident_tax_special_collection_switch.description: The hire asks to switch the resident tax to special collection (地方税法 art.321の4).

statutory.title: Statutory declarations
statutory.description: Employee registrations, exemptions and declared choices captured on this sealed contract.

HEALTH.title: 健康保険・介護保険 (Kyokai Kenpo health and nursing care insurance)

apportionment_ratio.title: 二以上事業所勤務の按分割合
apportionment_ratio.description: HEALTH / PENSION: this employer's share of the combined premium (健保則 art.1の2 notice).

bonus_as_remuneration.title: 年4回以上の賞与（報酬扱い）
bonus_as_remuneration.description: HEALTH: bonuses paid four or more times a year are 報酬 (健保法 art.3(5)); stops the bonus assessment.

care_exempt.title: 介護保険適用除外
care_exempt.description: HEALTH: a 40–64 insured person not domiciled in Japan (介護保険適用除外等該当届; 介護保険法 art.9(2)).

premium_adjustment_from.title: 保険料調整制度の開始月
premium_adjustment_from.description: HEALTH / PENSION: the month (YYYY-MM, October 2026 or later) the employer's 保険料調整制度 began, for a newly covered short-time worker; the employee:employer ratio is the statutory one for the standard monthly remuneration grade (126,000 or less) — years one and two, then half the reduction in year three, none after 36 months.

social_security_agreement_exempt.title: 社会保障協定による適用除外
social_security_agreement_exempt.description: HEALTH / PENSION: covered by a 適用証明書 under a social security agreement.

standard_monthly_remuneration.title: 標準報酬月額 (health)
standard_monthly_remuneration.description: HEALTH (read by every social insurance scheme). The health insurance standard monthly remuneration the pension office decided (資格取得時決定, 定時決定, 随時改定; 健康保険法 arts.41–43). The welfare pension grade is the same amount within 88,000–650,000. Unrecorded grades the contract monthly wage.

PENSION.title: 厚生年金保険 (employees' pension insurance)

apportionment_ratio.title: 二以上事業所勤務の按分割合
apportionment_ratio.description: HEALTH / PENSION: this employer's share of the combined premium (健保則 art.1の2 notice).

premium_adjustment_from.title: 保険料調整制度の開始月
premium_adjustment_from.description: HEALTH / PENSION: the month (YYYY-MM, October 2026 or later) the employer's 保険料調整制度 began, for a newly covered short-time worker; the employee:employer ratio is the statutory one for the standard monthly remuneration grade (126,000 or less) — years one and two, then half the reduction in year three, none after 36 months.

social_security_agreement_exempt.title: 社会保障協定による適用除外
social_security_agreement_exempt.description: HEALTH / PENSION: covered by a 適用証明書 under a social security agreement.

INCOME_TAX.title: 源泉所得税及び復興特別所得税 (salary and bonus withholding)

dependency_declaration_filed.title: 扶養控除等申告書 filed with this employer
dependency_declaration_filed.description: INCOME_TAX. 所得税法 art.194: the 給与所得者の扶養控除等(異動)申告書 filed with this employer (the main employer) — withholding by the 甲欄 and the bonus 甲 rates. Unfiled is the 乙欄.

secondary_dependants.title: 従たる給与の扶養親族等の数
secondary_dependants.description: INCOME_TAX: dependants on a 従たる給与についての扶養控除等申告書 (乙欄, 1,610 yen each; 月額表 備考2).

treaty_exempt.title: 租税条約による免除
treaty_exempt.description: INCOME_TAX: a non-resident's pay exempt under a tax treaty on the 租税条約に関する届出書.

withholding_dependants.title: 扶養親族等の数
withholding_dependants.description: INCOME_TAX. The number the declaration gives for the tables: 源泉控除対象配偶者 and 源泉控除対象親族 (including 特定親族 from 2026), plus one for each of the employee being a disabled person, widow, single parent or working student, and one for each disabled or co-resident specially disabled family member (月額表 備考 1(4)).

departure_date.title: 出国日
departure_date.description: YEAR_END_ADJUSTMENT: the day the employee leaves Japan (year-end adjustment at the last pay before it).

prior_employer_income.title: 前職の給与収入
prior_employer_income.description: YEAR_END_ADJUSTMENT: from the previous employer's 源泉徴収票 this year.

prior_employer_social_insurance.title: 前職の社会保険料
prior_employer_social_insurance.description: YEAR_END_ADJUSTMENT: from the previous employer's 源泉徴収票.

prior_employer_tax.title: 前職の源泉徴収税額
prior_employer_tax.description: YEAR_END_ADJUSTMENT: from the previous employer's 源泉徴収票.

yea_dependant_deduction.title: 扶養控除額
yea_dependant_deduction.description: YEAR_END_ADJUSTMENT: from the 扶養控除等申告書.

yea_housing_loan_credit.title: 住宅借入金等特別控除額
yea_housing_loan_credit.description: YEAR_END_ADJUSTMENT: the credit from the 住宅借入金等特別控除申告書.

yea_income_adjustment.title: 所得金額調整控除額
yea_income_adjustment.description: YEAR_END_ADJUSTMENT: 租税特別措置法 art.41の3の11 (salary over 8,500,000 with a dependant under 23 or disabled).

yea_insurance_deductions.title: 生命保険料・地震保険料・小規模企業共済等掛金控除額
yea_insurance_deductions.description: YEAR_END_ADJUSTMENT: from the 保険料控除申告書.

yea_other_income.title: 給与以外の所得
yea_other_income.description: YEAR_END_ADJUSTMENT: other income on the 基礎控除申告書, for the basic deduction tier.

yea_other_social_insurance.title: 申告による社会保険料控除額
yea_other_social_insurance.description: YEAR_END_ADJUSTMENT: social insurance paid directly (国民年金 etc.).

yea_personal_deductions.title: 障害者・寡婦・ひとり親・勤労学生控除額
yea_personal_deductions.description: YEAR_END_ADJUSTMENT: the personal deductions on the 扶養控除等申告書.

yea_specific_relative_deduction.title: 特定親族特別控除額
yea_specific_relative_deduction.description: YEAR_END_ADJUSTMENT: from the 特定親族特別控除申告書 (from 2025).

yea_spouse_deduction.title: 配偶者（特別）控除額
yea_spouse_deduction.description: YEAR_END_ADJUSTMENT: from the 配偶者控除等申告書.

RETIREMENT_TAX.title: 退職所得の源泉徴収 (retirement income withholding)

RESIDENT_TAX_RETIREMENT.title: 退職所得の分離課税 住民税 (resident tax on retirement income)

not_domiciled_on_january_1.title: 1月1日に国内に住所なし
not_domiciled_on_january_1.description: RESIDENT_TAX_RETIREMENT: no resident tax on the retirement income.

RESIDENT_TAX.title: 住民税 特別徴収 (resident tax special collection)

june_amount.title: 住民税 特別徴収 June amount
june_amount.description: RESIDENT_TAX. 地方税法 art.321の4: the June amount on the municipality's 特別徴収税額決定通知書.

lump_sum_on_exit.title: 一括徴収の申出
lump_sum_on_exit.description: RESIDENT_TAX: the leaver (June–December) asks for the rest of the year to be collected from the final pay (地方税法 art.321の5(2)).

monthly_amount.title: 住民税 特別徴収 monthly amount (July–May)
monthly_amount.description: RESIDENT_TAX. 地方税法 art.321の4: the monthly amount from July to May on the notice; replaced each June. Unrecorded is no special collection.

commute_car_km_one_way.title: Car commuting distance, one way (km)
commute_car_km_one_way.description: 所得税法施行令 art.20の2(ii): the non-taxable limit of a car or bicycle commuter's allowance by one-way distance. Unrecorded is a public-transport commuter (150,000 cap).

commute_parking_fee.title: Monthly parking fee borne (yen)
commute_parking_fee.description: From 1 April 2026 (令和8年度改正): a qualifying car park fee the commuter regularly bears adds up to 5,000 a month to the car limit.

commute_transit_fare.title: Monthly reasonable transit fare (yen)
commute_transit_fare.description: 所得税法施行令 art.20の2(iv): a commuter using both transport and a car adds the reasonable fare to the car limit, at most 150,000 a month.

insured_office_region.title: 適用事業所の都道府県
insured_office_region.description: The prefecture of the 適用事業所 the worker is insured at, where it is not the entity's (the 協会けんぽ 支部 rate).

minimum_wage_reduction_rate.title: 最低賃金の減額率
minimum_wage_reduction_rate.description: The reduction the labour bureau permitted for this worker (最低賃金法 art.7), as a fraction.

commuter_pass_months.title: 通勤定期券の月数
commuter_pass_months.description: Months a commuter pass paid at once covers (所得税基本通達 9-6の3).

daytime_student.title: 昼間学生
daytime_student.description: A daytime student, outside employment insurance (雇用保険法 art.6(iv)) and the short-time coverage.

childcare_short_hours.title: 育児短時間勤務
childcare_short_hours.description: The term is a 育児のための所定労働時間の短縮措置 (育児・介護休業法 art.23(1)); raises the 育児時短就業給付 application.

older_worker_continuation_benefit.title: 高年齢雇用継続給付 受給中
older_worker_continuation_benefit.description: 雇用保険法 art.61: the 60–64 worker’s wage fell below 75% of the 60歳到達時賃金 and the benefit is claimed (raises the two-monthly applications).

daily_wage_earner.title: 日雇（労働した日ごとに支払われる給与）
daily_wage_earner.description: 所得税法 art.185(1)(iii): pay paid for each day worked to a worker engaged by the day — withheld on the 丙欄. Not for pay continuing over two months (the part beyond two months is not 日雇 pay).

hazardous_work.title: 坑内労働・有害業務
hazardous_work.description: 労働基準法 art.36(6)(i) with 施行規則 art.18: overtime at most 2 hours a day.

specified_minimum_wage_work.title: 特定最低賃金の実際の業務
specified_minimum_wage_work.description: Actual principal operation and skill-acquisition status for every order assigned through the native workplace industry classifications. Order codes and operation labels come from specified_minimum_wage. Age and actual hire dates are native inputs; no assessed hourly minimum is captured.

separation_slip_requested.title: 離職票 requested
separation_slip_requested.description: 雇用保険法施行規則 art.7(2): the 離職証明書 is filed unless the leaver does not want the 離職票; a leaver aged 59 or over always gets it.

departure_abroad.title: 出国による退職
departure_abroad.description: The leaver departs abroad (年末調整 at the exit, 所得税法 art.190).

dismissal_exception_certified.title: 解雇予告除外認定
dismissal_exception_certified.description: 労働基準法 art.20(3): the labour standards office certified the exception.

renewal_count.title: 更新回数
renewal_count.description: Times the fixed-term contract was renewed (雇止め基準 art.1).

dismissal_restriction_lifted.title: 解雇制限の解除
dismissal_restriction_lifted.description: 労働基準法 art.19(1)–(2): 打切補償 (art.81) was paid, or the office certified that 天災事変 made continuing the business impossible.

severe_disability_prevents_reemployment.title: 著しい心身障害による退職で年内再就職不可
severe_disability_prevents_reemployment.description: Raw exit circumstance under所得税基本通達190-1(3): the employee leaves because of severe mental/physical disability and cannot be reemployed during the remaining tax year. This is not an annual-adjustment eligibility decision.

further_salary_expected_this_year.title: 退職後の年内給与受領見込み
further_salary_expected_this_year.description: Whether the employee expects any further salary from another employer after this exit in the same tax year. Required for low-income part-time and severe-disability midyear adjustment; eligibility and tax are computed from this premise and payroll income.

entity_extension_schema.title: JP entity extension data
entity_extension_schema.description: entity_extension_data. The entity region is the prefecture code of the prefectures rule set (HOKKAIDO … OKINAWA): it selects the 協会けんぽ rate and the regional minimum wage.

ei_industry_class.title: 雇用保険の事業の種類
ei_industry_class.description: 徴収法 art.12(4): general, agriculture/forestry/fisheries/sake brewing (with the listed exceptions that take the general rate), or construction.

workers_accident_rate_per_mille.title: 労災保険率 (per mille)
workers_accident_rate_per_mille.description: 徴収法 art.12(2)–(3) with 施行規則 別表第一: the rate of the business type (令和6年度改定) or the merit-adjusted rate on the labour insurance notice.

wage_deduction_agreement.title: 賃金控除協定 concluded
wage_deduction_agreement.description: 労働基準法 art.24(1) proviso: a written agreement with the majority union or representative permits deductions other than taxes and social insurance (loan recovery). Without it no loan class is offered.

withholding_semiannual_special.title: 源泉所得税の納期の特例
withholding_semiannual_special.description: 所得税法 art.216: approved semi-annual payment for an office paying fewer than 10 employees; raises WITHHOLDING_TAX_SEMIANNUAL instead of WITHHOLDING_TAX_PAYMENT.

resident_tax_semiannual_special.title: 住民税の納期の特例
resident_tax_semiannual_special.description: 地方税法 art.321の5の2: approved semi-annual payment for an office paying fewer than 10 employees (常時十人未満).

regular_employee_count.title: 常時雇用する労働者の数
regular_employee_count.description: Regular employees for the headcount-bound duties: the disability employment report (障害者雇用促進法 art.43(7); a short-time worker of 20–30 hours counts 0.5), the disability levy (100+). Unrecorded, the entity's employments in force (headcount) are counted.

health_insurer.title: 健康保険の保険者
health_insurer.description: 協会けんぽ (KYOKAI) or a 健康保険組合 (SOCIETY); a society employer records its own rates below.

society_health_rate_percent.title: 健康保険組合の一般保険料率 (%)
society_health_rate_percent.description: 健康保険法 art.160(13): the society's rate, within 3%–13%.

society_care_rate_percent.title: 健康保険組合の介護保険料率 (%)

society_support_levy_rate_percent.title: 健康保険組合の子ども・子育て支援金率 (%)
society_support_levy_rate_percent.description: 健康保険法 art.160の2: each insurer sets its own; unrecorded is 0.23%.

society_employee_share.title: 被保険者負担割合
society_employee_share.description: 健康保険法 art.162: a society may raise the employer's share; unrecorded is one half.

overtime_agreement_to.title: 36協定 有効期間の末日
overtime_agreement_to.description: 労働基準法 art.36: the filed agreement's last day; raises OVERTIME_AGREEMENT_RENEWAL and dates OVERTIME_WITHOUT_AGREEMENT.

overtime_special_clause.title: 特別条項付き
overtime_special_clause.description: 労働基準法 art.36(5): the agreement allows exceeding 45 h a month / 360 h a year.

labour_insurance_instalments.title: 労働保険料の延納
labour_insurance_instalments.description: 徴収法 art.18: the provisional premium is paid in three instalments (10 July, 31 October, 31 January).

weekly_limit_44.title: 特例措置対象事業場（週44時間）
weekly_limit_44.description: 労働基準法施行規則 art.25の2: under 10 workers in commerce, cinema/theatre, health or hospitality.

working_time_regime.title: 労働時間制度
working_time_regime.description: STANDARD, VARIABLE (変形労働時間制), FLEX (フレックスタイム制, one-month settlement) or DEEMED (みなし・裁量労働).

deemed_daily_hours.title: みなし労働時間
deemed_daily_hours.description: The deemed hours a day under a 裁量労働 or 事業場外みなし regime (労働基準法 arts.38の2–38の4).

overtime_sector.title: 時間外労働の上限規制の区分
overtime_sector.description: GENERAL, CONSTRUCTION, DRIVER (960 h), DOCTOR_A (960 h), DOCTOR_BC (1,860 h) or NEW_TECH_RD (outside the limits) (労働基準法 arts.36(11), 139–141).

disaster_recovery_work.title: 災害時の復旧・復興事業
disaster_recovery_work.description: Construction disaster recovery: the 100-hour and 80-hour rules do not apply (art.139).

hourly_leave_agreement.title: 時間単位年休の労使協定

annual_leave_pay_basis.title: 年休の賃金
annual_leave_pay_basis.description: ORDINARY (通常の賃金) or AVERAGE (平均賃金) for hourly and daily paid workers (労働基準法 art.39(9)).

statutory_return_count_two_years_prior.title: 基準年の法定調書の枚数
statutory_return_count_two_years_prior.description: Returns of a kind due two years before (所得税法 art.228の4).

work_rules_filed_on.title: 就業規則の届出日
work_rules_filed_on.description: The latest filing of the work rules (労働基準法 art.89).

next_generation_plan_until.title: 次世代法行動計画の終期
next_generation_plan_until.description: The end of the current next-generation action plan.

women_action_plan_until.title: 女性活躍行動計画の終期
women_action_plan_until.description: The end of the current women's advancement action plan.

health_check_month.title: 定期健康診断の実施月
health_check_month.description: The month the periodic health checks and the stress check are held (安衛則 arts.44, 52の9).

labour_insurance_association.title: 労働保険事務組合に委託
labour_insurance_association.description: Instalments fall on 14 November and 14 February (徴収則 art.28(2)).

voluntary_special_application.title: 任意特定適用事業所
voluntary_special_application.description: Short-time workers insured at an employer of 50 or fewer by labour agreement (令和2年法律第40号 附則).

variable_rest_days.title: 変形休日制（4週4日）
variable_rest_days.description: 労働基準法 art.35(2): four rest days in four weeks instead of one a week.

continued_employment_measure.title: 高年齢者雇用確保措置
continued_employment_measure.description: 高年齢者雇用安定法 art.9(1): the measure securing employment to 65.

industrial_physician_appointed_on.title: 産業医・衛生管理者 選任日
industrial_physician_appointed_on.description: 労働安全衛生法 arts.12–13: the day both were appointed (stops INDUSTRIAL_HEALTH_STAFF).

social_insurance_applicable_on.title: Health and pension insurance applicability began on
social_insurance_applicable_on.description: Actual date this establishment became applicable to Japanese health and employee pension insurance; differs from incorporation where coverage begins later.

labour_insurance_established_on.title: Labour insurance relationship established on
labour_insurance_established_on.description: Actual date the labour insurance relationship legally arose, including the reviewed opening date for pre-workspace coverage; do not replace it with incorporation.

employment_insurance_established_on.title: Employment insurance establishment began on
employment_insurance_established_on.description: Actual date the business became an applicable employment-insurance establishment, distinct from first employment of a person outside insured coverage.

payroll_office_opened_on.title: Japanese salary payment office opened on
payroll_office_opened_on.description: Actual opening date of the office handling salary-payment administration under Income Tax Act art.230, distinct from incorporation and the first date wages are paid.

region.title: 都道府県
region.description: The prefecture of the establishment (HOKKAIDO … OKINAWA). It selects the 協会けんぽ rate and the regional minimum wage. Required for a KYOKAI insured office.
